register.description: This register controls the various parameters of the OCP interface

bitfield.description: Idle Mode 0 local target's idle state follows (acknowledges) the system's idle reuquests unconditionaly, i.e. regardless of the IP module's internal requirments. Back mode, for debug only.1 local target never enteres idle state. Back mode, for debug only.2 local target's idle state eventually follows (acknowledges) the systems idle requests, depending on the IP modules internal requirments. IP module shall not generate (IRQ- or DMA-request-releated) wakuep events.3 local targets idle state eventually follows (acknowledges) the systems idle requests, depending on the IP module's internal requirents. IP module may generate (IRQ- or DMA-request-related) wakeup events when in idle state. Mode is only relevant if the appropriate IP module swakeup output(s) is (are) impolemented.
Emulation Mode 0 The timer is frozen in emulation mode (PI_SUSPEND signal active)1 The timer runs free, regardless of PI_SUSPEND value
Software reset 0 Read: Reset Done, no pending action Write: no action1 Read: Reset ongoing Write: initiate software reset
